test_InterfaceConfig_num_configurations: test that InterfaceConfig generates the correct number of atoms and metadata configurations
test_InterfaceConfig_solvent_density: test that solvent and ion atom counts match the specified density in InterfaceConfig
run_TestInterface_tests: run the pytest TestInterface class to validate InterfaceConfig behavior with adsorbates and solvents
create_InterfaceConfig_with_slab: create an InterfaceConfig from a Slab with adsorbates, solvent, ions, and vacuum parameters
review_TestInterface_fixture: review the load_data pytest fixture that sets up Bulk, Adsorbate, Solvent, and Ion test data
